title_zh: 亞斯納 第 10 章‧豪麻讚（中）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
vish apãm idha pateñtu vî daêvånghô
vî daêvayô, vanghush sraoshô mitayatu
ashish vanguhi idha mithnatu ashish vanguhi râmyat idha
upa imat nmânem ýat âhûiri ýat
haomahe ashavazanghô.
segments.en:
Let the Demon-gods and Goddesses fly far away from hence,
and let the good Sraosha make here his home! [And may the good
Blessedness here likewise dwell], and may she here spread delight
and peace within this house, Ahura's, which is sanctified by Haoma,
bringing righteousness (to all).
segments.zh: 讓惡魔與女魔從此處遠遠飛去，讓善的斯魯沙在此安家！〔願善的福樂亦在此居留〕，願她在此屋中散佈喜悅與安寧，此屋屬阿胡拉，經豪麻神聖化，帶來正義（予一切）。

segments.orig:
frataremcit tê havanem vaca upa-staomi huxratvô
ýô ãsush hañgeurvayeiti, uparemcit
tê havanem vaca upa-staomi huxratvô ýahmi nikhne
narsh aojangha.
segments.en:
At the first force of thy pressure, O intelligent! I praise
thee with my voice, while I grasp at first thy shoots. At thy
next pressure, O intelligent! I praise thee with my voice, when
as with full force of a man I crush thee down.
segments.zh: 在你第一次擠壓之力時，啊，智慧者！我用聲音讚美你，當我首先抓住你的枝條。在你下一次擠壓時，啊，智慧者！我用聲音讚美你，當我以一個人的全力將你壓碎。

segments.orig:
staomi maêkhemca vâremca ýâ-tê
kehrpem vaxshayatô barshnush paiti gairinãm, staomi
garayô berezañtô ýathra haoma urûrudhusha.
segments.en:
I praise the cloud that waters thee, and the rains which make
thee grow on the summits of the mountains; and I praise thy lofty
mountains where the Haoma branches spread.
segments.zh: 我讚美那澆灌你的雲，以及那使你在山巔生長的雨；我讚美你的高峻山巒，豪麻枝條在那裡伸展。

segments.orig:
staomi zãm perethwîm pathanãm verezyanghvãm
hvâparãm barethrîm tê haoma ashâum,
staomi zemô ýatha raodhahe hubaoidhish aurvô
carânem uta mazdå huruthma, haoma raose gara paiti
uta frâdhaêsha vishpatha haithîmca ashahe xå
ahi.
segments.en:
This wide earth do I praise, expanded far (with paths), the
productive, the full bearing, thy mother, holy plant! Yea, I praise
the lands where thou dost grow, sweet-scented, swiftly spreading,
the good growth of the Lord. O Haoma, thou growest on the mountains,
apart on many paths, and there still may'st thou flourish. The
springs of Righteousness most verily thou art, (and the fountains
of the ritual find their source in thee)!
segments.zh: 我讚美這廣闊的大地，向遠方展開（有路徑），豐產的，滿載的，你的母親，啊，神聖的植物！是的，我讚美那些你生長的土地，芬芳的，迅速蔓延的，主的良善生長。啊，豪麻，你在山間生長，在許多路徑上分開，願你仍在那裡繁茂。你確實是正義的泉源，（而儀式的源泉也在你之中找到源頭）！

segments.orig:
varedhayanguha (râspî,) mana vaca vîspêsca
paiti varshajîsh vîspêsca paiti frasparekhê
vîspêsca paiti fravâxshê. (vispêsca
... fravâxshê (2)!)
segments.en:
Grow (then) because I pray to thee on all thy stems and branches,
in all thy shoots (and tendrils) increase thou through my word!
segments.zh: （那麼）生長吧，因為我在你所有的莖與枝上向你祈禱，在你所有的芽（與卷鬚）中，藉著我的話語增長吧！

segments.orig:
(zôt,) haomô uxshyeiti stavanô, atha nâ
ýô dim staoiti verethrajãstarô bavaiti,
nitemacit haoma hûitish nitemacit haoma stûitish nitemacit
haoma hvareitish hazangrakhnyâi asti daêvanãm.
segments.en:
Haoma grows while he is praised, and the man who praises him
is therewith more victorious. The lightest pressure of thee, Haoma,
thy feeblest praise, the slightest tasting of thy juice, avails
to the thousand-smiting of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 豪麻在被讚美時生長，而讚美他的人也因此更具勝力。對你的最輕微擠壓，啊，豪麻，對你最微弱的讚美，對你汁液最細微的品嚐，足以千擊達埃瓦。

segments.orig:
nasyeiti hathra frâkeresta ahmat haca nmânât
âhitish ýathra bâdha upâzaiti ýathra
bâdha upastaoiti haomahe baêshazyehe cithrem dasvare
baêshazem ahe vîse uta maêthanem.
segments.en:
Wasting doth vanish from that house, and-with it foulness,
whither in verity they bear thee, and where thy praise in truth
is sung, the drink of Haoma, famed, health-bringing (as thou art).
[(Pazand) to his village and abode they bear him.]
segments.zh: 衰敗從那屋中消失，連同污穢，凡真正將你帶去之處，凡真正歌唱對你的讚美之處，那豪麻之飲，著名的，帶來健康的（如你）。〔（帕贊德）他們將他帶到他的村莊與居所。〕

segments.orig:
vîspe zî anyê maidhyånghô aêshma
haciñte xrvîm-drvô âat hô ýô
haomahe madhô asha hacaite urvâsmana, reñjaiti
haomahe madhô, ýô ýatha puthrem taurunem
haomem vañdaêta mashyô frâ âbyô
tanubyô haomô vîsâite baêshazâi.
segments.en:
All other toxicants go hand in hand with Rapine of the bloody
spear, but Haoma's stirring power goes hand in hand with friendship.
[Light is the drunkenness of Haoma (Pazand).]
Who as a tender son caresses Haoma, forth to the bodies of such
persons Haoma comes to heal.
segments.zh: 所有其他毒物都與血腥長矛的劫掠攜手同行，但豪麻的激奮之力與友誼攜手同行。〔豪麻的醉意是輕的（帕贊德）。〕誰如溫柔的兒子撫愛豪麻，豪麻便到這樣的人的身體前來醫治。

segments.orig:
haoma dazdi-mê baêshazanãm ýâbyô
ahi baêshazadhå, haoma dazdi-mê vârethrakhninãm
ýâbyô ahi verethra-taurvå, frâ-tê
vîsâi urvathô staota, urvathem staotârem
vanghanghem dadhô aoxta ahurô mazdå ýatha
ashem ýat vahishtem!
segments.en:
Of all the healing virtues, Haoma, whereby thou art a healer,
grant me some. Of all the victorious powers, whereby thou art
a victor, grant me some. A faithful praiser will I be to thee,
O Haoma, and a faithful praiser (is) a better (thing) than Righteousness
the Best; so hath the Lord, declaring (it), decreed.
segments.zh: 豪麻啊，在一切醫治之力中，凡使你成為醫治者的，請賜我一些。在一切勝利之力中，凡使你成為勝利者的，請賜我一些。我將成為你忠實的讚頌者，啊，豪麻！忠實的讚頌者比至善的真理更為可貴；主如此宣示並已裁決。

segments.orig:
aurvañtem thwâ dâmidhâtem bakhô
tatashat hvâpå, aurvañtem thwâ dâmidhâtem
bakhô nidathat hvâpå haraithyô paiti barezayå.
segments.en:
Swift and wise hath the well-skilled Deity created thee; swift
and wise on high Haraiti did He, the well-skilled, plant thee.
segments.zh: 善巧之神創造了你，使你敏捷而智慧；善巧之神在高聳的哈拉伊提山上栽種了你，使你敏捷而智慧。

segments.orig:
âat thwâ athra speñta fradaxshta merekha
vîzhvañca vîbaren avi ishata upâiri-saêna
avi staêra starô-sâra avi kusrâdha kusrô-patâdha
avi pawrâna vishpatha avi spita-gaona gairi.
segments.en:
And taught (by implanted instinct) on every side, the bounteous
birds have carried thee to the Peaks-above-the-eagles, to the
mount's extremest summit, to the gorges and abysses, to the heights
of many pathways, to the snow-peaks ever whitened.
segments.zh: 憑著（內植的本能）教導，恩惠的鳥兒從四面八方將你帶到鷹上之峰，帶到山巒的極頂，帶到峽谷與深淵，帶到多路徑的高處，帶到永遠雪白的雪峰之上。

segments.orig:
âat âhva paurvatâhva pouru-saredhô
vîraodhahe haomô gaoma zairi-gaonô, â-tê
baêshaza irîrathare vanghêush mananghô
mayâbyô, âat mê ahe dushsanghahe parâca
vaêpaya manô, âat ahe manô manô
ýô mê dushsanghô hishtaite!
segments.en:
There, Haoma, on the ranges dost thou grow of many kinds.
Now thou growest of milky whiteness, and now thou growest golden;
and forth thine healing liquors flow for the inspiring of the
pious. So terrify away from me the (death's) aim of the curser.
So terrify and crush his thought who stands as my maligner.
segments.zh: 豪麻啊，在那裡，在群山之上，你以多種形態生長。時而你長成乳白色，時而你長成金黃色；你的醫治之水向前流淌，以激勵虔誠之人。請從我這裡嚇走詛咒者的（死亡）目標。請嚇走並粉碎那站在我面前誹謗我之人的念頭。

segments.orig:
nemô haomâi ýat kerenaoiti drikhaosh havat-masô
manô ýatha raêvastemahecit, nemô haomâi
ýat kerenaoiti drikhaosh havat-masô manô ýat
usnãm aêiti vaêdhya, pourunarem tûm kerenûshi
spainyanghem cistivastarem ýase-tê bâdha haoma
zâire gava iristahe baxshaite.
segments.en:
Praise be to thee, O Haoma, (for he makes the poor man's thoughts
as great as any of the richest whomsoever.) Praise be to Haoma,
(for he makes the poor man's thoughts as great as when mind reacheth
culmination.) With manifold retainers dost thou, O Haoma, endow
the man who drinks thee mixed with milk; yea, more prosperous
thou makest him, and more endowed with mind.
segments.zh: 讚美歸於你，啊，豪麻！（因為他使窮人的心思變得如同最富有者一樣偉大。）讚美歸於豪麻！（因為他使窮人的心思變得如同心智達到頂點時一樣偉大。）啊，豪麻！你用眾多的隨從裝備那以乳調和飲用你的人；是的，你使他更加興旺，更加富有心智。

segments.orig:
mâ-mê ýatha gâush drafshô âsitô
vârema caire, frasha frayañtu tê madhô
verezyanguhånghô jaseñtu, pairi-tê haoma
ashâum ashavâzô dadhãmi imãm tanûm
ýâ mê vaênaite huraodha!
segments.zh: 不要像雨中的奶滴一樣突然從我眼前消失；願你的令人興奮之力永遠強勁而新鮮地前行；願它們以強烈的效力降臨於我。啊，神聖的豪麻，禮儀真理的承載者啊！在你面前，我要獻上此身，此身（眾人可見，適於奉獻且已）長成。

segments.orig:
avangherezâmi janyaosh ûnãm mairyayå
evîtô-xaredhayå ýâ mainyeiñti
davayeiñti âthravanemca haomemca hâ ýâ
dapta apanasyeiti, ýâ tat ýat haomahe draonô
nigångheñti nishhadhaiti nôit tãm âthravô-puthrîm
naêdha dasti huputhrîm!
segments.en:
I renounce with vehemence the murderous woman's emptiness,
the Jaini's, hers, with intellect dethroned. She vainly thinks
to foil us, and would beguile both Fire-priest and Haoma; but
she herself, deceived therein, shall perish. And when she sits
at home, and wrongly eats of Haoma's offering, priest's mother
will that never make her, nor give her holy sons!
segments.zh: 我猛烈地棄絕那殺戮之女的空虛，那賈伊尼的，她的，心智被廢黜的。她徒然以為能欺騙我們，想要誘騙火祭司和豪麻；但她自己，反在其中受騙，終將滅亡。當她坐在家中，錯誤地食用豪麻的供品時，那永遠不會使她成為祭司之母，也不會賜予她神聖的兒子！

segments.orig:
pañcanãm ahmi pañcanãm nôit
ahmi, humatahe ahmi dushmatahe nôit ahmi, hûxtahe
ahmi duzhûxtahe nôit ahmi, hvarshtahe ahmi duzhvarshtahe
nôit ahmi, sraoshahe ahmi asrushtôish nôit ahmi,
ashaonô ahmi drvatô nôit ahmi atcit ahmât
ýatha apemem manivå anghat nivâitish!
segments.en:
To five do I belong, to five others do I not; of the good
thought am I, of the evil am I not; of the good word am I, of
the evil am I not; of the good deed am I, and of the evil, not.
To Obedience am I given, and to deaf disobedience, not; to the
saint do I belong, and to the wicked, not; and so from this on
till the ending shall be the spirits' parting. (The two shall
here divide.)
segments.zh: 我屬於五者，不屬於另外五者；我屬於善思，不屬於惡思；我屬於善言，不屬於惡言；我屬於善行，不屬於惡行。我歸屬於順從，不歸屬於聾愚的不順從；我屬於聖者，不屬於惡人；因此從此刻直到終結，將是兩靈的分離。（二者將在此分開。）

segments.orig:
âat aoxta zarathushtrô, nemô haomâi
mazdadhâtâi, vanghush haomô mazdadhâtô,
nemô haomâi, vîspe haoma upastaomi ýatcit
barshnushva gairinãm ýatcit jãfnushva raonãm
ýaêcit ãzahu deretånghô jaininãm
upadarezâhu, erezataêna haca tashta zaranaênem
aoi taxshe, mâ-tê nîre zemi paiti itha raêvañtô
arejahe!
segments.en:
Thereupon spake Zarathushtra: Praise to Haoma, Mazda-made.
Good is Haoma, Mazda-made. All the plants of Haoma praise I, on
the heights of lofty mountains, in the gorges of the valleys,
in the clefts (of sundered hill-sides) cut for the bundles bound
by women. From the silver cup I pour Thee to the golden chalice
over. Let me not thy (sacred) liquor spill to earth, of precious
cost.
segments.zh: 於是查拉圖斯特拉說：讚美豪麻，馬茲達所造。豪麻是善的，馬茲達所造。我讚美豪麻的一切植物，在高山的頂上，在峽谷的深處，在（裂開的山側）的裂縫中，為婦女所捆的束所切。我從銀杯將祢倒入金盞之上。願我不將祢（神聖的）液體灑落地上，那是寶貴的代價。

segments.orig:
imåse-tê haoma gâthå imå heñti
staomâyô imå heñti cîcashânå
ime heñti arshuxdha vâcô dâsmainish vârethrakhnish
paiti-bishish baêshazya.
segments.en:
These are thy Gathas, holy Haoma, these thy songs, and these
thy teachings, and these thy truthful ritual words, health-imparting,
victory-giving, from harmful hatred healing giving.
segments.zh: 這些是祢的伽薩，神聖的豪麻，這些是祢的歌，這些是祢的教誨，這些是祢的真實儀式之言，賦予健康，賜予勝利，治癒有害的仇恨。

segments.orig:
imåse tûmcit mâvôya, frasha frayañtu
tê madhô raoxshna frayañtu tê madhô,
reñjyô vazaiti madhô vârethrakhnish heñtem
âstaoite hathra ana gâthwya vaca,
segments.en:
These and thou art mine, and forth let thine exhilarations
flow; bright and sparkling let them hold on their (steadfast)
way; for light are thine exhilaration(s), and flying lightly come
they here. Victory-giving smiteth Haoma, victory-giving is it
worshipped; with this Gathic word we praise it.
segments.zh: 這些和祢是我的，讓祢的興奮流出；明亮而閃爍，讓它們保持（堅定）的道路；因為祢的興奮是輕的，飛快地來到這裡。賜予勝利的豪麻擊打，賜予勝利的被崇拜；用這伽薩之言我們讚美它。

segments.orig:
gave nemô gave nemô gave uxdhem gave verethrem
gave hvarethem gave vastrem, gavê verezyâtãm
tãm nê hvarethâi fshuyô!
segments.zh: 讚美母牛；讚美和勝利（要）對她說！給母牛食物，和牧場！『為了母牛，讓節儉使用勞苦；賜給我們食物。』

segments.orig:
haomem zâirîm berezañtem ýazamaide,
haomem frâshmîm frâdat-gaêthem ýazamaide,
haomem dûraoshem ýazamaide, vîspe haoma ýazamaide,
zarathushtrahe spitâmahe idha ashaonô ashîmca
fravashîmca ýazamaide. ýenghê hâtãm
âat ýesnê paitî ... !!
segments.en:
We worship the yellow lofty one; we worship Haoma who causes
progress, who makes the settlements advance; we worship Haoma
who drives death afar; yea, we worship all the Haoma plants. And
we worship (their) blessedness, and the Fravashi of Zarathushtra
Spitama, the saint.
<H2 id=y11
segments.zh: 我們崇拜那黃色崇高的；我們崇拜豪麻，祂帶來進步，祂使聚落前進；我們崇拜豪麻，祂驅逐死亡；是的，我們崇拜所有豪麻植物。我們也崇拜（它們的）福樂，和斯皮塔瑪的查拉圖斯特拉，那位聖者的弗拉瓦希。
